page: Microsoft Azure EC16as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECasv6 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs present on this model, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio, the EC16as_v6 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local scratch space or hardware acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This profile is suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and data analytics tasks that fit within the 128.0 GB memory boundary.
